question: 42 numaralı mağazada fiyat anormalliği var mı?

args.query:
SELECT 
    t.id AS transaction_id,
    t.product_id,
    p.name AS product_name,
    p.category,
    p.unit_price AS catalog_price,
    t.unit_price AS transaction_price,
    t.quantity,
    t.ts
FROM transactions t
JOIN products p ON t.product_id = p.id
WHERE t.store_id = 42
ORDER BY t.product_id, t.ts
overcharged wrong price

SELECT 
    t.id AS transaction_id,
    t.product_id,
    p.name AS product_name,
    p.catalog_price,
    t.unit_price AS transaction_price,
    t.quantity,
    t.ts,
    ROUND((t.unit_price - p.catalog_price) / p.catalog_price * 100, 2) AS price_diff_pct
FROM transactions t
JOIN (SELECT id, name, unit_price AS catalog_price FROM products) p ON t.product_id = p.id
WHERE t.store_id = 42
  AND t.unit_price <> p.catalog_price
ORDER BY price_diff_pct DESC

output.summary: 42 numaralı mağazada 15 Ağustos 2026 tarihinde ciddi bir fiyat anormalliği tespit edildi. 10 işlemde, ürünlerin birim fiyatı katalog fiyatının tam olarak 100 katı olarak kaydedilmiş (örneğin Milk için 2.99 yerine 299.0, Tea için 5.49 yerine 549.0). question: 42 numaralı mağazada aynı işlemin çok kısa bir süre içinde defalarca tekrarlandığı bir durum var mı?

args.query:
SELECT 
    t1.id AS transaction_id_1,
    t2.id AS transaction_id_2,
    t1.product_id,
    t1.quantity,
    t1.unit_price,
    t1.ts AS ts_1,
    t2.ts AS ts_2,
    ROUND((JULIANDAY(t2.ts) - JULIANDAY(t1.ts)) * 24 * 60, 2) AS diff_minutes
FROM transactions t1
JOIN transactions t2 
    ON t1.store_id = t2.store_id
    AND t1.product_id = t2.product_id
    AND t1.quantity = t2.quantity
    AND t1.unit_price = t2.unit_price
    AND t1.id < t2.id
    AND ABS(JULIANDAY(t2.ts) - JULIANDAY(t1.ts)) * 24 * 60 <= 5
WHERE t1.store_id = 42
ORDER BY diff_minutes ASC;

SELECT 
    id,
    product_id,
    quantity,
    unit_price,
    ts
FROM transactions
WHERE store_id = 42
  AND product_id = 4
  AND ts BETWEEN '2026-08-15T14:14:00' AND '2026-08-15T14:16:00'
ORDER BY ts;
SELECT name, category, unit_price FROM products WHERE id = 4;

output.summary: 42 numaralı mağazada ciddi bir tekrar işlem anomalisi tespit edildi. 2026-08-15 tarihinde saat 14:15:00 ile 14:15:29 arasında — yani yalnızca 29 saniye içinde — tamamen aynı işlem (Ürün: Coffee, miktar: 2, unit_price: 8.99) tam 30 kez art arda gerçekleştirilmiş. findings.claim: 42 numaralı mağazada, 2026-08-15 tarihinde 14:15:00–14:15:29 arasındaki yalnızca 29 saniyelik dilimde, tamamen aynı işlem (product_id=4 / Coffee, miktar=2, unit_price=8.99) 30 kez tekrar etmiştir. question: 42 numaralı mağazadaki hatalı fiyatlı işlemleri analiz et ve raporla. Veritabanında hiçbir değişiklik yapma.

args.query:
SELECT t.id AS transaction_id, t.product_id, p.name AS product_name, p.category,
       p.unit_price AS catalog_price, t.unit_price AS charged_price,
       t.quantity, t.ts,
       ROUND(t.unit_price - p.unit_price, 4) AS price_diff,
       ROUND((t.unit_price - p.unit_price) * t.quantity, 4) AS total_overcharge
FROM transactions t
JOIN products p ON t.product_id = p.id
WHERE t.store_id = 42
  AND t.unit_price <> p.unit_price
ORDER BY ABS(t.unit_price - p.unit_price) DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_transactions,
       SUM(CASE WHEN t.unit_price <> p.unit_price THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mispriced_count,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.unit_price <> p.unit_price THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS mispriced_pct
FROM transactions t
JOIN products p ON t.product_id = p.id
WHERE t.store_id = 42
SELECT id, name, city FROM stores WHERE id = 42

SELECT 
  category,
  COUNT(*) AS mispriced_count,
  ROUND(SUM((t.unit_price - p.unit_price) * t.quantity), 2) AS total_overcharge
FROM transactions t
JOIN products p ON t.product_id = p.id
WHERE t.store_id = 42
  AND t.unit_price <> p.unit_price
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY total_overcharge DESC
